$comment: Known flaky tests that get two retries in CI only (process.env.CI), never locally. Each entry names its file, its full test name (describe blocks and test joined with ' > '), an owner and the evidence. A retried test is listed in its vitest job's summary. Fix the test, then delete its entry. docs/ci.md, 'Flaky tests'.

tests.test: waking a sleeping computer > forgets a server error once a later resume is accepted
tests.reason: Failed 7 runs (3 main runs) since Sep 24: Ubuntu 5, Windows 2. #2444 targeted it; delete this entry once no retry is reported for a week.

tests.test: a bot's memory and a lent Mac (server/lending-memory.ts) > fingerprints the instruction files an engine reads in each working folder and the folders above it
tests.reason: Failed 8 runs (7 branches, 2 main runs) since Sep 24, Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: a phone's v1 live view on real Chrome > sends the events and fields the agent-browser engine sent, step for step
tests.reason: Failed 11 times since Oct 26 in browser driver S4 (ubuntu-latest), on the host and in the container; five of the six logged failures are one stall of about 50 s in which navigate through tab-new get no picture. Not reproduced in 72 runs on ubuntu-latest on Oct 29. Each attempt starts its own Chrome.

tests.test: the v2 stream on real Chrome > sends the page's file picker to the person holding the browser, and their files to the page
tests.reason: Failed in four S4 runs on Nov 21 across two unrelated branches (PR #35 ×2, PR #37 ×2), both ubuntu and windows legs: the upload POST dies with write EPIPE / ECONNABORTED while real Chrome is under CI load. S4 runs every attempt on a fresh Chrome.

tests.test: T9 parks the root on a sign-in card and runs it again with the signed-in line on Done
tests.reason: Failed once (Nov 18 CI round) on a busy ubuntu shard; green locally and in the other rounds of the same PR.

tests.test: F4 keeps a second assignment Clive hands Mira in the same turn its own job, though the first is already running
tests.reason: Failed once (Nov 18 CI round) on a busy shard; green locally and in the other rounds of the same PR. Recurred Nov 22 on a loaded shard — Mira's fake had not spawned when Clive's two-step turn ended (ready-file check ran immediately after the turn); the check is now host-scaled and polled.

tests.test: runs a room member's turn a restart cut again once, told so, and resumes the sender told so
tests.reason: Failed once (Nov 18 CI round) on a busy shard; green locally and in the other rounds of the same PR.

tests.test: a run of a guest's routine is the guest's: confined, and so is work it hands a teammate
tests.reason: Failed twice across the Nov 17-18 CI rounds on ubuntu shards, different sibling tests each time; green locally in every run. Recurred Nov 22: the owner's routine turn read as confined — either a real guest-scope leak or turnWith matching a late-flushed row (guest and owner routine prompts are identical); the assertion now dumps the matched turn's index/thread/prompt so a repeat is self-diagnosing.

tests.test: brings Ben's reply back to Scout in Cleo's chat, where Scout carries on, and his Chief takes no turn
tests.reason: Failed twice across the Nov 17-18 CI rounds on busy shards, then all three attempts on Nov 21 (PR #37 ubuntu shard 1), on Nov 22 release lane, and Nov 22 PR #44 shard 1/8 alongside its sibling — each time the relayed reply parked in the steer queue and no wake event ever re-ran the drain (dispatch gates can release after the last settle event); green in every local run. A retry-drain now re-checks parked lines while any queue is non-empty, so a stranded wake self-heals; kept listed as the wedge class is still being proven.

tests.test: a browser on Windows > lists a real browser under cmd.exe with its daemon, keeps it for that daemon and stops it for another
tests.reason: Failed once (Nov 18 CI round) on a loaded windows shard; cmd.exe listing is windows-only and cannot be reproduced locally.

tests.test: T12 a turn the watchdog stops after it posted a credential card fails as stalled and stops the card
tests.reason: Failed once (Nov 18 CI round) on a windows shard; a sibling test of this suite flaked in an earlier round and both are green locally and in the other rounds.

tests.test: PiDriver turns (fake CLI) > expires a prewarmed child its turn never claimed, and removes its credential dir
tests.reason: Failed three times (Nov 17-18 CI rounds), always on loaded windows shards: the spawn's credential dir appears past the waits even at 10 s; green locally every time. Keep raising the headroom or skip on windows if it keeps reporting.

tests.test: R7 a goal step the watchdog stops after it posted a credential card fails as stalled and stops the card
tests.reason: Failed once (Nov 18 CI round) on a busy ubuntu shard: the accelerated stall sweep ran past the 20 s poll; the poll now waits 45 s and the suite is green locally.

tests.test: a reply in the chat answers the sign-in request: the card settles, nothing waits under Needs you, and Done no longer resumes the old turn
tests.reason: Failed twice (Nov 18 CI rounds incl. a failed-jobs rerun) on ubuntu: the thread read settled where needs-user was expected; green in every local run.

tests.test: lets a tag Ben answered in the chat it came from leave his Needs you
tests.reason: Failed twice on Nov 18 (a CI round and its failed-jobs rerun) on ubuntu shard 1, then again on Nov 21 (main release run + PR #37, all attempts), and Nov 22 PR #44 shard 1/8 alongside its sibling — same stranded-queue signature (POST accepted, no turn ever dispatched); green in every local run. Test timeout raised to 240 s; a retry-drain now re-checks parked lines while any queue is non-empty.

tests.test: waits for a busy delegated worker, preserves its direct turn, then resumes the goal
tests.reason: Failed five times across Nov 17-18 CI rounds on busy shards despite the widened busy window (15 s) and end waits (25 s), and again on Nov 21 (PR #37 ubuntu shard 4); green in every local run.

tests.test: T12 a turn the watchdog stops after it posted a sign-in card fails as stalled and stops the card
tests.reason: Failed on loaded ubuntu shards in two consecutive Nov 22 CI runs (poll saw root still running at 180s); 3/3 green locally in 44s — watchdog sweep starvation under shard load. Credential-card sibling already listed.

tests.test: lunabot headless: team apply → run --wait job → export > stops a job whose teammate hangs when its time runs out, the teammate included
tests.reason: Failed twice on loaded ubuntu shards (Nov 22, all three attempts): teammate readyFile never landed inside the job timeout — engine spawn latency under shard contention. The 4 s timeout is now host-scaled (8 s on CI); green locally.

tests.test: VPS turn routing e2e (fake pi fleet + fake docker over SSH) > runs two turns of one bot on the VPS at once; the desktop is claimed by the first computer call and waited for by name
tests.reason: Failed once on a loaded ubuntu shard (Nov 22): no computer MCP reached the agent inside the provisioning window; green locally in 8s.

tests.test: T8 Stop while parked on a sign-in card cancels the root and stops the card; Cancel afterwards is saved but starts nothing
tests.reason: Failed once on a loaded ubuntu shard (Nov 22): root raced to completed before the parked card state — green locally.

tests.test: on a Team Cloud, a secret typed into a card in a member's private chat > leaves the team's secret of the same name as it was, which every other chat still gets
tests.reason: Failed once on a loaded ubuntu shard (Nov 22): member-scoped secret fell back to the team one — card/save path raced; assertions hardened to name the racing step; green locally.

tests.test: S4 pages, tabs and page state on real Chrome > goes back and forward through documents and fragments, and reloads
tests.reason: Failed on ubuntu S4 twice (Nov 22): the back-forward restore reran the page script — a bfcache miss under the memory pressure of four live Chrome instances; page.back() uses Page.navigateToHistoryEntry, so restore is Chrome's call. The sessionStorage.loads counter also carried over across retries (2→3→4), making every rerun an automatic fail; the key is now unique per attempt so retries can pass. Green in every earlier S4 run.

tests.test: ends a stopped turn with one quiet stop, keeps what it said, and a second Stop on it leaves the queued message running
tests.reason: Failed once on a loaded ubuntu shard (Nov 22 main run): an SSE frame wait hit its 60 s host-scaled window on a shard that took 574 s for the file set; the frame dump now names event types/ids so a repeat shows which stage stalled. Green locally in 6.4 s.

tests.test: authorization decisions are logged > a card and the human's allow write two rows
tests.reason: Failed twice on loaded ubuntu shards (Nov 24, PR #68 and PR #71 runs): the requestId-scoped waitForDecision matched a sibling test's card-shown row ('native-approval' where 'no-grant' was expected) — likely the card's requestId read before it fully formed, leaving the filter unscoped. The sibling CSV-count assertion failed in the same run. Green locally.

tests.test: the bots' browser service on real Chrome > answers a click that opened the next page with that page: a link, a form the page submits, a script's location change
tests.reason: Failed once on the release-lane macOS S4 (Nov 22): agent_browser_click answered 'No element matches #script' — the click reached the fresh page before its DOM was ready; macOS Chrome spawn under full-matrix load. Green everywhere else.

tests.test: a cloud computer goes to sleep after its idle window > a stop the relay refuses is logged and retried after a longer wait each time
tests.reason: Failed twice on loaded ubuntu shards (Nov 24: main #89 run shard 6, PR #91 shard 6): the 1s/2s backoff stops did arrive (~1s/~2s gaps in the relay log) but the third did not land inside the 10s host-scaled waitFor window under shard load. Green locally.
